title: Learn Skill Pro
purpose: Paid online course platform with protected lessons, enrollment reviews, certificates and affiliate management.
stack: PHP 8.3+, Laravel 13, Blade/Vite, PDF generation, relational database
subtitle: A course journey from discovery through enrollment to certificates.
summary: Laravel learning platform for course discovery, paid enrollment, protected videos, learning administration, certificates and referral management.
overview: The GitHub inventory describes an online learning and course-administration platform. Unlike the existing Test The Ummah examination system, this repository focuses on paid course enrollment, protected lecture media, certificate issuance and affiliate/referral workflows. Live payments and media protection were not runtime-audited.
focus: A source-described learning experience spanning course discovery, paid enrollment decisions, protected content and certificates.
